text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Toronto and East York Community Council to extend the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Grant Street, between Queen Street East and the north end of Grant Street and Kintyre Avenue, between Broadview Avenue and Grant Street, from 12:01 p.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week. By extending the overnight on-street permit parking hours, residents will have improved parking flexibility and the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, can effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Grant Street, between Queen Street East and the north end of Grant Street and Kintyre Avenue, between Broadview Avenue and Grant Street, from 12:01 p.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week. 2. Approved the amendment of the 1 hour temporal parking maximum on Kintyre Avenue, between Broadview Avenue and Grant Street, from 10:00 a.m. to 12:01 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., 7 days a week.
